fields.statement: The conductor's land commit is recognised by trailers rhiza writes, not by a new attribution rule: rhiza land --commit lands, renders and commits .rhiza with Change: and Actor: trailers (the actor every write resolves, the conductor session's own), and the conduct guide makes it the conductor's land step; handCommits' rule (Decision hand-commit-by-trailer) is unchanged, so a person's commit with only a Change: trailer still counts as a hand commit

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(land-commit|describe-golden)$' passes: land-commit.txtar lands an accepted change set with RHIZA_ACTOR set and rhiza land --commit --json, then git log -1 --format=%(trailers) shows Change: <the change set> and Actor: <that actor's handle>, git status --porcelain .rhiza is empty, and a file staged outside .rhiza before the land is still staged and not in the commit; (failure case) rhiza land --commit on a draft change set exits non-zero with HEAD unchanged and nothing committed; (failure case) rhiza land --commit --dry-run is a usage error with nothing landed or committed; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated with the new land request type
fields.must_not: Change rhiza land without --commit, or the other lifecycle verbs' requests; commit anything outside .rhiza; push; change ship land's own commit (internal/api/ship_close.go); change handCommits' attribution rule
fields.statement: rhiza land --commit lands the change set, renders, stages .rhiza and commits only .rhiza with the message 'Land and render the change set' and the trailers 'Change: <change set ID>' and 'Actor: <actor handle>' (the actor the land entry was written as, resolved as every write resolves it: RHIZA_ACTOR, else git's user.email; its ID when it has no handle), all in one trailer block; without --commit land behaves as today

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestHandCommitsConductorLandCommit passes: on a run branch (handCommitBranch), the land operation with commit set, run as the actor of a session recorded with the run (Run R1), makes a commit and scanHand finds no hand commit; (failure case) the same land commit made as an actor whose only session belongs to another run (R2) is journalled as one hand-commit intervention naming that actor
fields.must_not: Change internal/api/run_handcommit.go or the existing hand-commit tests' expectations
fields.statement: A test shows that the commit rhiza land --commit makes as a conductor session's actor, on its run's branch, is the run's: handCommits journals no hand-commit intervention for it

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide -run 'TestConduct|TestConductHandback|TestBuildReviewCommandBudget' passes: TestConduct asserts conduct.md's Land phase names rhiza land --commit and the Change: and Actor: trailer rule; TestConductHandback asserts conduct-handback.md's closing land names rhiza land --commit; (failure case) the old 'rhiza land, then rhiza render, and commit what they change' wording is asserted absent from both topics
fields.must_not: Change other roles' guide topics (builder, rhiza, change-sets, planner); add a phase to the conduct guide
fields.statement: The conduct guide's Land phase and conduct-handback's closing land tell the conductor to land, render and commit with rhiza land --commit, and say every other commit the conductor makes carries Change: and Actor: trailers, so none is journalled as a hand commit
